headlines.title: Trump threatens to bomb Oman if it ‘gets in the way’ of Strait of Hormuz talks with Iran
headlines.description: Monday marks the end of a 60-day deadline that the U.S. and Iran agreed to in June to end the war and reach an agreement on Iran’s nuclear program.

headlines.title: Send Steve Kornacki your questions about this week’s Florida primaries and more
headlines.description: ill start breaking down all the results at the big board.

headlines.title: Florida Democratic Socialist House candidate downplays labels & touts ‘people-centered policies’
headlines.description: Florida state Rep. Angie Nixon (D) joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss her campaign for Senate. Nixon, who recently joined the Democratic Socialists of America, discusses the divide within the Democratic party between progressive and establishment candidates.

headlines.title: ‘We need fresh new leaders’ says Democrat challenging Debbie Wasserman Schultz
headlines.description: Elijah Manley (D-Fla.) joins Meet the Press NOW ahead of Tuesday’s primary elections in Florida. Manley discusses his effort to challenge incumbent Rep. Debbie Wasserman Schultz (D-Fla.) and discusses the need to “fight fire with fire” after Florida Republicans redrew the state’s congressional map.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Supreme Court turns away Trump’s latest bid to block E. Jean Carroll award
headlines.description: The Supreme Court turned away for a second time President Donald Trump’s bid to overturn a jury verdict that awarded $5 million to writer E. Jean Carroll and found Trump liable for sexual abuse and defamation.

headlines.title: Trump orders military to ‘substantially reduce’ joint exercises with South Korea
headlines.description: The president said he has directed the Pentagon to scale down the exercises, citing South Korea’s refusal to join the war in Iran and his “very good” relationship with North Korea’s Kim Jong Un.

headlines.title: Rep. Ro Khanna calls for ‘Data Center Bill of Rights’ and says the industry needs regulation
headlines.description: The California congressman also laid out how he believes he differs from Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, as both progressives are floated as potential presidential candidates.

headlines.title: Attorney General Todd Blanche says DOJ may take states’ voter roll fight to Supreme Court
headlines.description: Todd Blanche said there’s a “possibility” that the Justice Department will ask the Supreme Court to rule on cases in which the federal government’s is trying to gain access to state voter rolls ahead of November’s midterm elections.

headlines.title: Map: How much you pay in federal and state gas taxes
headlines.description: As national gas price averages head toward $5 per gallon, one state has already suspended its gas tax, and now President Donald Trump and his Cabinet are talking about doing the same.
